svg.text: DIAMOND BOOKING — FULL STACK BOOKING SaaS
Complete Development + Deployment + Debugging Workflow (Correct Stack)

g.text: Goal: stable local dev + correct production env + payments + webhooks + reminders
Goal: fast local iteration → safe preview → safe production
Use Stripe test mode in Preview
1) Reproduce → 2) Locate surface (UI/API/DB/Auth/Stripe) → 3) Inspect logs/events → 4) Fix + add guardrail → 5) Re‑run build
Goal: tenant-safe queries + correct booking + billing as source of truth
State changes happen server-side (never trust client billing state)
Never accept businessId from client payload
Public booking: /book/[slug] → availability → create booking → email/SMS → schedule reminders
Billing: /dashboard/billing → Stripe Checkout → Stripe Webhook → Subscription updated → plan limits enforced
Booking correctness: timezone-safe availability + in-transaction conflict checks
Webhook correctness: signature verified + idempotent events
Stripe webhook is the source of truth for plan/status
Goal: predictable deploys + safe previews + fast rollback
Preview test: booking creation, billing checkout (test mode), webhook replay, login/logout, dashboard navigation
After prod deploy: check Stripe Events, webhook delivery, cron run logs, and booking confirmation email delivery
Never deploy without passing local “npm run build”
Set in Vercel (Preview + Production). Do not hardcode URLs in code.
SMS: Twilio vars or GHL provider vars
